<thought>Based on the given data, the compound is most consistent with phenylacetaldehyde (C8H8O), which consists of an aromatic benzene ring (6 aromatic carbons) and a side‑chain aldehyde (CH2‑C=O). The two fragments that can be joined to form the whole molecule are therefore the benzene ring and the aldehyde side chain. Their SMILES strings are “c1ccccc1” for the aromatic fragment and “CC=O” for the aldehyde fragment.</thought>
<final_answer>['c1ccccc1', 'CC=O']</final_answer>
